name: Personal Desk
description: A calm personal problem desk that turns messy life/work concerns into next actions, missing context, and agentic follow-through.
permission_rationale: The app stores only its own desk items and can open Live App Studio when the user chooses to make a personalized copy.

ai_context.original_prompt: A built-in Starter App demonstrating an old-friend style assistant that helps users organize personal concerns into next actions.
